value.rationale: The first explicitly constructed projective characteristic-five nonliftable Calabi–Yau threefold motivates computation of arithmetic Frobenius data. An exact zeta function for its canonical smooth proper Kummer resolution, including all finite extensions, answers a natural open computation beyond the source Betti ranks and proves a positive Tate spectrum; the twist-count mechanism is structural rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
